record_type_quote:
SCORE Report: Direct Replication of a Research Claim (Study 3) from
            Usta & Häubl (2011), in Journal of Marketing Research

targets.title: Self-regulatory strength and consumers’ relinquishment of decision control: When less effortful decisions are more resource depleting.
targets.evidence_quote:
The claim selected for replication from Usta & Häubl (2011) is that remembering a decision
that a person delegated in the past depletes self-regulatory resources more than remembering
an independently made decision (H3; pages 408-409 of original manuscript).
targets.outcome_quote:
This replication attempt did not confirm hypothesis brought forward by original
authors. Dessert preferences did not evidence any trend associated to the Dependent and
Independent conditions, and an overall preference for chocolate cake is observed (albeit not
statistically significant).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict covers both stages of the one replication. The target is Study 3 only, not Study 4 mentioned in the original abstract.

reasoning: Primary eight-page completed SCORE report, including final citation. File title, project identifier and named replication author verify the assigned work; project contributors checked. Report is dated 2020 by OSF file metadata despite assigned 2025 metadata; identity otherwise matches.
